parameters.query:
SELECT 
  workflow_name,
  COUNT(*) as error_count,
  MAX(created_at) as last_error_at,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT error_message, ' | ' ORDER BY error_message) as error_messages
FROM workflow_errors
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
  AND resolved = false
  AND alert_sent = false
GROUP BY workflow_name
ORDER BY error_count DESC

SELECT 
  'scheduled_messages' as check_type,
  COUNT(*) as stuck_count,
  MIN(scheduled_datetime) as oldest_stuck
FROM scheduled_messages
WHERE status = 'pending'
  AND scheduled_datetime < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'cleaning_tasks' as check_type,
  COUNT(*) as stuck_count,
  MIN(scheduled_date::timestamp) as oldest_stuck
FROM cleaning_tasks
WHERE status = 'pending'
  AND scheduled_date < CURRENT_DATE
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'maintenance_tickets' as check_type,
  COUNT(*) as stuck_count,
  MIN(created_at) as oldest_stuck
FROM maintenance_tickets
WHERE status = 'pending'
  AND urgency IN ('emergency', 'high')
  AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'unprocessed_deals' as check_type,
  COUNT(*) as stuck_count,
  MIN(last_message_at) as oldest_stuck
FROM deals
WHERE status = 'awaiting_response'
  AND last_message_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '4 hours'

SELECT 
  property_id,
  property_name,
  owner_contact
FROM property_configurations
WHERE property_status = 'active'
  AND calendar_sync_enabled = true
  AND (
    last_calendar_sync IS NULL 
    OR last_calendar_sync < NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours'
  )

UPDATE workflow_errors
SET alert_sent = true,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
  AND resolved = false
  AND alert_sent = false;

-- Also mark workflow_errors older than 7 days as resolved if still open
UPDATE workflow_errors
SET resolved = true,
    resolved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    resolved_by = 'system_auto_resolve'
WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND resolved = false;
